Chicken Tikka Masala | IFN
By: ravikumar
Published: Thursday, January 25, 2018 - 1:43am

Ingredients




500g boneless chicken
1 bowl cream
50g cashew
50g almonds, soaked and peeled
1 tbsp ghee (clarified butter)
1/2 cup tomato puree
3 tbsp of mustard oil
1 cup of curd (dahi)
1 tbsp garlic paste
red chilli powder
jeera powder
coriander powder
garam masala
black pepper
salt
2 green chillies
a few coriander leaves
2 tbsp finely chopped tomatoes and onions

Preparation

1 1. Add the ginger and garlic paste into the chicken along with garam masala powder,black pepper powder,coriander powder, jeera powder, red chilli powder, salt, mustard oil and curd. 2 2. Mix well until the chicken is marinated and bake it in the oven. 3 3. In a blender, add in cashews, almonds, tomatoes, onions, chillies, coriander leaves, cream, tomato puree, water and salt. 4 4. Mix this well and layer it with the baked chicken. 5 5. Bake the whole dish for a little longer, garnish and serve.

About

Chicken Tikka Masalais a classic dish and very popular for its taste and beautiful aroma in all around the world. Indian chicken tikka masala recipe is so easy to make and full of flavour. Chicken tikka masala is the better option for Dinner or Lunch. Authentic Chicken Tikka Masala Recipe is the most loved recipe and very popular dish.
